content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

The Agreement's only liability limitation sits at the end of the indemnity section (p0077) and caps *TrueLink alone* at 12 months' hosting/support compensation, and only for "Section 3, 4, 7 and 11" matters, with carve-outs limited to TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Client's exposure — including the very broad Section 12a indemnity — is unlimited. That combination (Customer uncapped / Vendor capped) is walk-away territory, and the clause also fails the fallback carve-out set (no indemnification or confidentiality carve-out) and is not an aggregate cap.

The validated redline is a single surgical replacement to the existing sentence, targeting the **fallback**: the cap becomes each party's aggregate liability across the whole Agreement, retaining the existing 12-month fee basis, with indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and wilful misconduct expressly outside the cap. Preferred items not pressed (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, data protection/security, fraud and IP carve-outs, payment-obligation carve-in) are noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
